record.question: Patients suffering from which of the following disorders also suffer from 'Sun-downing'
record.explanation: Answer B: Dementia. Sundowning is a behavioral pattern commonly seen in dementia, with worsening confusion/agitation later in the day. Source/context note: Sundowning is not unique to Alzheimer’s disease and can occur in other contexts. Reference: https://www.alz.org/help-support/caregiving/stages-behaviors/sundowning. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
